faq_items.question: What sizes of custom printed cups do you produce?
faq_items.answer: We produce custom printed paper cups in 4 oz (120 ml), 7 oz (180 ml) and 8 oz (240 ml) sizes.

faq_items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq_items.answer: Minimum order quantity varies by size and design. Contact us via WhatsApp or our contact form for a current quote.

faq_items.question: What file formats do you accept?
faq_items.answer: We accept AI, PDF, PNG and high-resolution JPG formats. Vector files are preferred for print quality.

faq_items.question: How long does production take?
faq_items.answer: Production time after approval depends on order volume. Delivery timeline is shared during the quoting stage.

faq_items.question: Do you offer white and kraft cups?
faq_items.answer: Both white and kraft options are available. Contact us for substrate options depending on the cup size.

about.title: About Us
content: Kardak was established 4 years ago with an innovative and customer-focused approach. With our growing team and modern production facility, Kardak aims to be a leading name in the industry.
We manufacture paper cups in all sizes, providing customized solutions to meet our clients' diverse needs. Additionally, we supply high-quality paper for paper cup production.
Kardak also offers tailored printing and cutting services to make your production processes faster and more efficient.
With our eco-friendly and sustainable production philosophy, Kardak continues to add value for the future.
